title: I'm creating a MTG playing AI with GPT. here's the progress so far <3
author: Mean-Committee-4035
selftext:
Like the post says =)

I'm starting with a very small cardpool (black midrange vs red aggro). I'm currently coding the engine to use GPT api calls, but after I can get an engine finished and stable I hope to flip to a local model and open source so everyone can run it locally while i continue to plug away at adding additional cards and expanding the card pool.

the cards/decks that i have chosen as the phase 1 demo are:

comments.author: bob101910
comments.body: Very neat project, but what makes it different from all the existing MTV games?

replies.author: Mean-Committee-4035
replies.body: Great question. I'm not using unity, screen scrapers, or the like. I'm coding the engine from scratch in python, to ensure that the gamestate, cards, etc are in a native machine readable format

comments.author: h455566hh
comments.body: You may want to try more specialised AIs for development. If you're using Unity or Unreal there are thing like Bezi that are tailored for gamedev support.
